descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S24 Existing specs: each text-generation call records the model that answered and the vendor the data went to

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 Each run records which AI ran each step: the note model, the speech-to-text engine (GPT-Live streaming; Deepgram only when ambient is on), and the models for pre-round processing, photo capture and A … (UAT 3.9; UAT 3.1; TFA-94423 AC 7)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given provider-fallback.spec.ts fixtures and an api session on the local stack

When Run a call that falls back from Haiku to Mistral, a normal call, and an ai.* call

Then For text generation: the diagnostics row names the answering model, with fellBackFrom set when the call fell back from Haiku to Mistral; the audit row names disclosed_to aws_bedrock and the model (PF-04-02); an ai.* text call records its vendor without recording the PHI.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in api/provider-fallback.spec.ts and api/audit.spec.ts. UAT 3.9 'record which AI ran each step', for the text-generation steps only. Speech-to-text recording is S12 (unit tests) and TC-23 S08; photo-model recording is TC-02 U10 and is not checked by these tests.

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-05.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-05/S24

Existing specs: each text-generation call records the model that answered and the vendor the data went to

Tickets: TFA-94423 Implement GPT-live medical mode for active dictation (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/OAT-05.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • api/audit.spec.ts [api] — an ai.* call records the disclosure without recording the PHI — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-04-01 log shows the answering model — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-04-02 audit row shows it too — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's api specs e2e/api/provider-fallback.spec.ts and e2e/api/audit.spec.ts): provider-fallback stubs bedrock.invoke in-process, and audit.spec signs in a local fixture account and reads audit rows through e2e/support/backend.ts with the local admin key; dev has no admin key and one share…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
